summary: Eni S.p.A., the Italian oil-and-gas major, filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report) disclosing open-market repurchases on Euronext Milan during 28 September–2 October 2026. It bought 4,137,494 shares equal to 0.14% of capital at a weighted average price of €24.1692, for €99,999,941.18, under the second tranche of a buyback approved at the 6 May 2026 shareholders' meeting to fund an additional shareholder remuneration alongside dividends. Since the 8 May 2026 program start, Eni has repurchased 77,277,221 shares (2.55%) for €1,754.9 million and holds 164,105,328 treasury shares, 5.42% of capital. Watch for tranche completion and buyback-to-dividend substitution pacing.
